causes_and_fixes.cause: Schedule test advanced its fake clock while the initial offline 404 request could still be pending; the next poll was skipped as busy and backoff began at the advanced time.
causes_and_fixes.fix: Wait for the initial schedule completion note before installing the next test response. Controlled delayed-response proof records zero refresh requests without the boundary and one with it.

causes_and_fixes.cause: WebKit skips native link Tab stops; boundary-only modal trap lets focus leave Close for BODY.
causes_and_fixes.fix: Traverse eligible visible modal controls explicitly in both directions, retaining modifier shortcuts, Escape and return focus.

causes_and_fixes.cause: WebKit native link mousedown focuses carousel ancestor; disclosure focusin dismissal removes link before click.
causes_and_fixes.fix: Keep disclosure during its own mouse/touch compatibility focus transition; reset guard on mouseup, pointercancel, blur, keydown and close.

causes_and_fixes.cause: An empty-page anchor to the synthetic tv.apple.com event triggers neither a routable request nor a browser page on this macOS WebKit build.
causes_and_fixes.fix: Retain exact original provider URL assertions, then alias only the Apple host to apple-player.fixture.invalid for offline native-anchor activation. Preserve path/query, popup event, null opener and unchanged source assertions.

independent_review.result: No blocking findings for current rendered content; focus traversal, pointer keyboard reset and final navigation harness reviewed.

initial_schedule_failure.detail: One invalid-snapshot case observed zero refresh requests because initial fetch completion raced fake-clock advancement; no invalid payload was parsed. Final harness waits for the initial completion note.

limitations: The Apple original-host behavior is observed; native application handoff is an inference and was not inspected.
Offline browser checks do not prove provider playback, sign-in, original Apple-host resolution or mobile physical-device behavior.

Independent reviewer found that a synthetic CSS visibility:hidden modal control would remain an unfocusable candidate; current rendered dialogs have no such controls, so this future hardening remains outside this fix.
